policy_choice: Selected stronger simple C0 on closed T0 development panel (46 full-correct versus rules 38). Collect new observable states; executed teacher decisions are not labels.
start_condition: Mixed one-update fit and exported dev6 validation terminal, original ledger reconciled, no other actual model job. Train first; dev only after train terminal and first-failure review.
retained_existing_data: Reuse old T0 operation trajectories and reviewed labels unchanged; no replay of old positions. Existing rules/generative diversity remains, later T2 adds current-policy trajectories.
supervision: Review actual source pools and actual Host requests; source-bound witnesses label short-range operation preferences, not native-answer imitation. Ambiguous preferences masked.
limits: Existing Host/model/prompt/request and return budgets; same actual Store, independent banks per interface. No model service change.
failure_policy: First failures and costs retained. Known response length/format failures with no unknown-usage increase advance only to untouched next positions; unexpected failure stops for inspection. No automatic replay.
accounting: Original continuous ledger only; no second model job or offline settlement while model job active.
constraint: Current retrieval schema feedback disables SHA fingerprints; no checksum or replacement fingerprints. Historical receipts retained.
training_status: New T1 not labelled/fitted. Final mixture and equal-update comparison budget frozen after actual usable label counts.
interpretation: Mixed-source, mixed-collector development expansion, not an isolated collector effect, holdout result or native-tool validation.
